# Spark Control Center 1.2.1

This is the final combined templates, batch-operations, alerting, and diagnostics release. It supersedes 1.2.0 by adding immutable PostgreSQL version snapshots for every alert-rule change.

![Versioned SparkApplication templates](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ApolloMeridian/spark-application-webui/v1.2.1/docs/images/templates-1440.png)

![Proactive alert center](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ApolloMeridian/spark-application-webui/v1.2.1/docs/images/alerts-1440.png)

## Highlights

- Versioned, parameterized SparkApplication templates with validation and explicit Secret-data rejection.
- Shareable application filters, server-side pagination/sorting, per-user favorites, and permission-aware batch operations.
- Versioned failure, long-pending, resource-pressure, and repeated-retry alert rules.
- Alert evidence, confidence, recommendations, acknowledgement, silence, recovery, failure fingerprints, and optional generic JSON webhook delivery.
- Idempotent in-place database migration from 1.1.0 or 1.2.0.

## Release assets

- `spark-control-center-1.2.1.tar` — frontend image (`spark-control-center:1.2.1`).
- `spark-control-center-backend-1.2.1.tar` — backend image (`spark-control-center-backend:1.2.1`).
- `spark-control-center-1.2.1.tgz` — Helm chart.
- `SHA256SUMS` — checksums for packaged artifacts.

The image names do not contain a private registry prefix.
